plain.li: [season:spring] when the geese came back
[season:spring] in the moon of the first green
[season:spring] when the river ran loud with the melt
[season:spring] when the calves stood up for the first time
[season:spring] the morning the frost let go of the ground
[season:spring,home:coast] when the fish came back up the river
[season:spring,their:herders] in the season of new lambs
[season:summer] in the time of the long days
[season:summer] when the berries were red on the low bushes
[season:summer] in the moon of the dry grass
[season:summer] when the nights were short and the children would not sleep
[season:summer] when the bees were loudest
[season:summer,home:desert] when the waterholes shrank to the size of a hand
[season:summer,their:grovekeepers] when the old trees were in full leaf
[season:autumn] when the nut trees let their nuts fall
[season:autumn] in the moon of the falling leaves
[season:autumn] when the geese went south
[season:autumn] when the smoke of the drying racks hung over the camp
[season:autumn] when the first frost came in the night
[season:autumn,their:herders] when the herds came down from the high grass
[season:winter] in the moon of the long dark
[season:winter] when the river froze
[season:winter] when the snow lay to the knee
[season:winter] when the wolves came close to the fires at night
[season:winter] in the season of old stories
[season:winter,home:frozen] in the dark that has no sunrise
[season:winter,home:mountains] when the passes closed
